title: make the `body`-dialect producer table come from a SCAN, not an enumeration — the first deliverable is the CRITERION, not another count
body:
Make the `body`-dialect **producer table come from a SCAN, ⛔ not from an ENUMERATION**. Opened on triage's explicit instruction; ⛔ this is the successor to filing producers one at a time, and ⛔ no further one-at-a-time producer card should be opened.

## The instruction, verbatim

Triage, answering the `pm:retriage` on objectui#9847 at 2026-09-18T12:00Z (record `5729672625`): 判定 **A —— 条件视为已触发**.

> **开一张**「**让 `body` 方言的生产者表由扫描产生,⛔ 不由枚举产生**」的卡,把上面两个站点作为**首批证据**带进去,⛔ 不再各自立卡。⚠️ **本席无 `issue_write`** ⇒ 请 `domain:ui` 执行席(或任一有立卡通道的席位)开,并**回链本卡与 objectui#7181**。

⇒ filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat on that instruction. ⛔ No `priority:*` and no `domain:*` set here — an execution seat never grades or routes.

## ⭐ Why the clause fired even though the census read CLEAN

objectui#7181's escalation clause named the **census** as its instrument, and the census was clean: its `app-metadata` bucket went **1 → 0** when objectui#9847 landed. A **second** instrument — a child-list-shaped `body` sweep over shipped source, with a `children` control lit in the same command — resolved **two live sites** the census cannot reach:

| site | why the census structurally cannot see it |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/CompletionProvider.ts:108` · `:133` · `:145` | the spelling lives in a **string literal**, and the census never reads inside one. ⭐ Accepting that completion writes a `body` key into the user's **own document** — the author never types the spelling |
| `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/tabs.tsx:88-90` (shipped `defaultProps`) | a tab **item** carries `label` / `value` / `body` and **no `type`**, and the census scores a child list only on an object that **also** carries a string-literal `type` |

Both verified at source by the filing seat on `origin/main` at 2026-09-18T11:32Z; both absent from PR objectui#9846's 13 files.

⇒ ⭐ **what these two share is ⛔ not that they were missed — it is that NO instrument in the tree could have found them.** Triage's words: 「这两个的共同点⛔ 不是『被漏了』,是『树里没有任何仪器能找到它们』」.

## ⭐⭐ The first deliverable is THE CRITERION, ⛔ not another count

Triage was explicit:

> ⭐ 那张卡的第一交付物应当是**判据本身**(「什么算一个生产者」),⛔ 不是再数一遍:两个新站点已经证明,**按「带 `type` 的对象」计分**这一条分类键**永久看不见**字符串字面量与无 `type` 的 item。

⇒ the question is ⛔ not 「how many are left」. It is **「what makes this table complete」** — and the current classifier answers that with a key that is provably blind in two directions.

⚠️ A deliverable that re-runs `pnpm census:body-dialect`, adds two entries and declares the population closed would reproduce **exactly** the defect this card exists to end.

## ⚠️ One family question belongs HERE, ⛔ not in a third card

Is a `body` child list on a **non-node ITEM** (a tab item, which has no `type`) inside objectui#6771's ruled family at all? ⛔ Unruled. Triage: 「⛔ 本席不代裁,但它**属于那张新卡的第一交付物**,⛔ 不该再拆出第三张。」 ⇒ the criterion has to answer it, because a classifier cannot score what it has not defined.

## ⚠️ What the current census declares about itself — the limits are documented, ⛔ not bugs

`scripts/body-dialect-census.mjs` scores a child list only on an object that also carries a **string-literal `type`**, and it never reads **inside a string or template literal**. Both limits are declared. ⇒ this card is ⛔ not a bug report against the census; it is about a table whose completeness the census was never able to certify.

## ⭐ The downstream consequence, and why this is not cosmetic

`scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts` carries the block 「the platform SHIPS the dialect it is being asked to refuse」, which objectui#9858 re-pointed at the two sites above. Its own comment states the exit condition: re-point it 「at whatever still ships the dialect — or, once nothing does, say so here in these terms, **which is the day step 4 becomes landable**」.

⇒ **objectui#6771 step 4 (the tier teaches `children` only) cannot land until this table is trustworthy.** Today it is not, and the reason is this card.

## Dedupe words

- `body` dialect producer table scan not enumeration
- census cannot read string literals
- producer classifier keyed on literal `type`
- what counts as a producer criterion
- tab item `body` non-node child list

## Related

objectui#9847 (the card whose retriage fired this; its two sites are the first evidence) · objectui#7181 (the six-producer migration and the clause) · objectui#6771 (the five-step retirement whose step 4 waits on this) · objectui#9858 / objectui#9846 (the landed PRs)

## 维护者速读

组件树里「一个节点的子内容」历史上有两种拼法:`body` 和 `children`。您已经裁过:`children` 是唯一拼法,`body` 退役(objectui#6771)。这张卡交付的是**判据**——什么算一个「还在生产 `body` 的地方」——而扫描器一上线就撞到一个**没人裁过**的边界:

**标签页/列表的「条目」(item)上也有 `body`,而条目根本不是节点**:它没有 `type`,它自己的规范键叫 **`content`**,不叫 `children`。⇒ 已裁家族的补救措施(「改写成 `children`」)在条目这一面**指向一个不存在的键**。

扫描器把这类站点标成 `unruled:item-carrier` 并**拒绝**把它算进已裁总数——⛔ 它没有替谁决定。

**问:条目上的 `body` 算不算 objectui#6771 那个家族?A 算 / B 自成一族 / C 根本不是方言问题,而是一个生产者违反了自己已发布的 schema。**

| 选项 | 做什么 | 代价 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A 算** | 条目站点并入已裁家族,随 #6771 的步骤一起走 | ⚠️ 家族的补救是「改成 `children`」,而条目面没有这个键 ⇒ 要先答「条目面的规范键是什么」,等于**扩大**一个已裁家族的边界 |
| **B 自成一族** | 为条目面单开一条退役轨 | 多一条要长期维护的家族义务,而它今天只有两个已知消费点 |
| **C 不是方言** | 认定条目面的规范键就是 `content`,于是这是一个**生产者 bug**:shipped 默认值违反了自己已发布的 `TabItemSchema` | 需要改 shipped 默认值的输出形状;对既有消费者的影响**未量** |

## 四棱

- **① 项目长远合理性**:C 特例最少——条目面已经有自己的规范键,不需要任何新声明;A **扩大**已裁家族的边界(是「扩大」,⛔ 不是「拉回已声明契约」);B 新开一族。按①:**C**。
- **② 实际业务拉动**:⭐ 实测的,而且与家族归属**无关**:shipped `tabs` 的 `defaultProps` 今天就发出**不合法**的条目(`invalid_type ["content"] expected nonoptional, received undefined`,对照:同一条目改写成 `content` 解析通过)。作者把平台自己的默认值抄进元数据会被自家校验器拒收。已立卡 objectui#9941。⇒ 支持 C,因为 C 的修法就是修这件事。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错**:C 的失败是**响亮的**(schema 拒收);A/B 都要求作者(常常是 AI)记住第二套拼法——节点用 `children`、条目用另一套。闭合枚举优于自由结构。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散**:C **不新增任何声明**;A 给已裁家族加边界,B 加一条家族。每个已声明的键都是永久义务。

⛔ **The `Prior rulings read:` line published here earlier was run in the WRONG REPO's checkout, and this seat is correcting it in place.** (Corrected at 2026-09-18T20:35Z, clock read by this write.) `check-prior-rulings.mjs` has no `--repo` flag by design — its own docblock says 「the CORPUS is always THIS checkout … so a flag naming a different board would read a card from one repo and answer it out of another repo's rulings, **with nothing in the output saying so**」 — and this seat ran it from the objectstack checkout and pasted the answer onto an objectui card. Measured: objectui's `docs/adr/` holds **0001, 0034, 0036, 0053–0059** only; **ADR-0021, ADR-0029 and ADR-0061 do not exist in this repo** (they do in objectstack, control run in the same command). Both readings, labelled:

- **Prior rulings read (THIS repo, objectui — `AGENTS.md` + `docs/adr/**`)**: `body dialect` / `producer` / `census` → **3 hits**, in `AGENTS.md` and `docs/adr/0036`.
- **Prior rulings read (objectstack's corpus — the shared protocol's rulings, relevant where this card touches the contract, ⛔ NOT this repo's numbering)**: body,dialect,producer,census → 13 hits; ADR-0090 D10, ADR-0029 D9.6, ADR-0058 D7, ADR-0067 D3, ADR-0076 D11, ADR-0094 D1, ADR-0094 D2, ADR-0102 D1, ADR-0106 D6

**推荐:C**,回退项 **B**。自检:「只看①选 C;②③④ 是否翻转:**否**——②③④ 同向。」⭐ 这与承接 dev 的推荐一致,但是本席按四棱**自己推出来的**,⛔ 不是沿用。

**置信缺口**:① 本席**未量**条目面 `body` 的历史来源——是否曾有裁定把它当作家族的一部分;objectui#9256 把条目通道**单独立卡并刻意 pin live**,说明至少有一个席位已把它当独立事项处理,⛔ 但那不是裁决。② C 落地会改变 shipped 默认值的输出形状,**对既有消费者的影响未量**——两个读点都走 `any` cast,所以类型层看不见它们。

**裁后执行**:裁 **C** ⇒ objectui#9941 就是它的执行卡(把 shipped 默认值按 `TabItemSchema` 拼成 `content`),扫描器把 `unruled:item-carrier` 这条标注改成「不是方言」并从待裁列表移除;裁 **A** ⇒ 先答「条目面的规范键是什么」,再把 item-carrier 折进已裁总数,#6771 的 step 2/3 补上条目面的补救;裁 **B** ⇒ 立一张条目面家族卡,#6771 不动,扫描器保留现在的 `unruled:item-carrier` 分类。

<sub>四棱块由 `domain:ui#2` 执行席在本卡进决策箱时补齐(2026-09-18T20:31Z);⛔ 本席不改级别、不改路由,⛔ 也不代裁。交付物的落地验证与 dev 的完整测量见本卡评论线;扫描器对这一类的处置是**拒绝折叠**,所以裁哪个字母都⛔ 不需要回滚已落地的代码。</sub>
